issue.title: Later bank views after the trial: typical comparisons, year card, Stats metric, Mac idle line, week-note fence
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-kd.7 (bank epic wrap-up, note #2); listed as follow-up 2 in
`plan:202611/bank_daily_acknowledgment.md` ("Later views, after a 2–4 week trial", design
call 11: no "typical" comparisons in v1 because they are noise without history).

Gate: start only after Bryan's 2–4 week bank trial, with at least two months of bank rows
in `bank/YYYY-MM.md`. As of 2026-11-12 the live vault has only `bank/2026-11.md`, with no
rows typed yet.

Candidate views (every number drawn from `bob bank … -f json`, never written to notes):

- typical week/month comparisons in the `bob-bank` month card;
- a year card;
- a `bank` Stats metric;
- a bank line in Bob Mac Capture's idle agenda (bob JSON first; the app stays a thin
  client per decisions:mac-capture-is-a-thin-client);
- a week-note fence.

Re-scope from the trial's findings before planning; likely an epic across bob-cli,
bob-plugins (bob-ledger-tools), and bob-mac-capture. Note the plan's privacy rule: v1
adds no bank data to agent-facing outputs (period briefs, Stats, the Mac app), so a Stats
metric or Mac line needs an explicit decision from Bryan.

task_type_fields.proposal: After the bank trial, add typical week/month comparisons, a year card, a bank Stats metric, a Bob Mac Capture idle-agenda bank line, and a week-note fence, all drawn from bob bank JSON.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The bank epic plan excludes typical comparisons from v1 (no history yet) and gates these views on a 2-4 week trial with at least two months of rows.

issue.creation_reason: The bank epic shipped v1 views without history-based comparisons on purpose; bob-cli-kd.7 proposed revisiting the views once a 2-4 week trial yields two months of rows.
